name: app-6997e5b66a7c81918d598a8f2f4afac2
description: Make songs from a description or your own lyrics, play them with their lyrics, change the words of one part, or remake a song in a new style. Songs are saved to your Neume account.

interface.longDescription:
Neume makes original songs. Describe the song you want, or give your own lyrics, choose the sound, and the song is made in your Neume account. It plays right in the chat, with its lyrics highlighted as they're sung.

After that you can change the words of one part of a song, such as a verse or a chorus, and hear it sung again in the same voice while the rest stays as it is. Or you can make the whole song again in a new style. Each change makes a new song and keeps the original.

You can also attach audio in the chat: hum or sing an idea and Neume turns it into a full song, or upload a song and change the words of one part.

You need a Neume account to use it, and making or changing a song uses credits from that account. Every song is saved to your account, so you can also play it in the Neume app and on app.neume.io.
capabilities: Make songs from a description or your own lyrics
Turn a hum or a recording into a song
Change the lyrics of one part of a song
Remake a song in a new style
defaultPrompt: Make a short upbeat song for my dog's birthday
Change the chorus of my latest song

positive.expected_behavior: A card lists the test account's songs, newest first, each with a play button that plays the song in the card; 'Show more' loads the next page.

positive.description: Play one song with its lyrics
positive.expected_behavior: A song card shows the cover, title and style, a play button and a seek bar; it plays, and the lyrics button shows the lyrics with the sung line highlighted.

positive.description: Make a new song after confirming the lyrics
positive.prompt: Make a short upbeat pop song about Monday mornings
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant first shows a title, a style and lyrics with [Verse]/[Chorus] tags and asks to go ahead. After the reviewer agrees, generate_song is called once; the card shows a progress bar and turns into a player when the song is ready (about a minute).

positive.description: Change the words of the chorus
positive.prompt: Change the chorus of my most recent song so it's about the beach
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant finds the song's chorus with get_song_parts, proposes new chorus lines and asks to go ahead. After agreement, change_lyrics makes a new song with the chorus sung again in the same voice; the card shows progress, then plays it. The original song is unchanged.

positive.description: Remake a song in a new style
positive.prompt: Make an acoustic version of my most recent song
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant confirms the new style (acoustic), then reimagine_song makes a new song with the same words in that style; the card shows progress, then plays it. The original song is kept.

negative.description: Buying credits isn't possible in the chat
No real artist's voice or name
negative.prompt: Make a song sung in Taylor Swift's voice

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold in ChatGPT. Making or changing a song uses credits the user already has in their Neume account; the plugin never shows plans or prices or links to a purchase page.

publication.release_notes: First release: make songs from a description or your own lyrics, play them in the chat with synced lyrics, change the words of one part of a song, and remake a song in a new style.
